title: What Is Attention in an LLM? Explained in 20 Seconds
description:
Learn how attention lets each word in a sentence look at the other words, score them, and use softmax weights to build its meaning.

The example sentence, scores and weights shown are made up for illustration; they are not output from a real model.

Built with HyperFrames (HeyGen) and GSAP.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
